§6Iron Anvil§f

§aEverything in HBM starts here. This is your workbench for the entire early game.§f

The §bIron Anvil§f is how you shape plates, wire, and build machines. Right-click it, pick a recipe from the catalog, load your materials, and hit the hammer.

It's also the only way to craft the assembly machine and blast furnace, so you need one ASAP.

§6Anvil Tiers§f:
§bTier 1§f: Iron / Lead
§bTier 2§f: Steel
§bTier 3§f: Desh
§bTier 4§f: Ferrouranium
§bTier 5+§f: Saturnite, Bismuth Bronze, Ferric Schrabidate, Dineutronium, Osmiridium, Murky

Higher tiers unlock more recipes. Upgrade by putting 10 ingots of the new material plus your current anvil into the GUI.

§ePS:§f A §blead anvil§f works at Tier 1 too. Same thing, different metal.
